entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: The natural sciences college of Strixhaven University, whose magic centers on life gain and draws on life and death, green and black magic.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: The university on Arcavios that houses the Witherbloom college.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Strixhaven University stands.

entities.name: Beledros Witherbloom
entities.description: The elder dragon who founded the Witherbloom college.

entities.name: Sedgemoor
entities.description: The bayou encompassing the Witherbloom campus, home to strange swamp beasts and potion ingredients.

entities.name: Detention Bog
entities.description: A stinking marshland adjacent to the Sedgemoor where misbehaving students are sent.

entities.name: Widdershins Hall
entities.description: The center of the Witherbloom campus, a bog mansion grown out of Sedgemoor.

entities.name: Wiltroot Hall
entities.description: A hall built in the hollow trunk of a long-dead tree above a swamp.

entities.name: Pests
entities.description: Salamander-like irritating creatures used as Witherbloom mascots and sources of life essence.

entities.name: Valentin
entities.description: A Vampire, the black-aligned dean of Witherbloom (former, deceased).

entities.name: Lisette
entities.description: A Human Druid, Witherbloom's green-aligned dean.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who was a Witherbloom professor, originally as Professor Onyx.

relations.quote: The founder of the college is the elder dragon Beledros Witherbloom
